subject: Clarifying record-keeping: invoices, usage logs, and deletion requests
messages:
From: Jenny Park <jenny.park@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Accounting <acct-team@acme-corp.com>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question on invoice/usage retention vs. customer deletion requests

Hi Marissa,

Quick question from our audit team: we need to confirm how Redwood treats invoices and underlying usage records when an end-user of ours submits a data deletion request. Specifically:

- Are invoices and billing records (PDF invoices, line-item usage summaries) retained even if the associated user or tenant requests deletion?
- How long do you keep raw usage logs and token-level data for billing reconciliation?
- Is there an option to limit retention or keep billing data only in the EU region for our EU customers?

We have an upcoming internal audit and need a short blurb we can include in our compliance package. Appreciate anything concise you can share.

Thanks,
Jenny Park
Accounting Manager
Acme Corp
[jenny.park@acme-corp.com]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on invoice/usage retention vs. customer deletion requests

Hi Jenny — thanks for the clear questions. Short answers up front, followed by a slightly expanded note and next steps.

Short answers:
- Invoices and finance records (PDF invoices, invoice metadata, charge summaries) are retained for accounting and regulatory purposes and are not removed in response to a routine customer-initiated data deletion request.
- Usage logs and token-level telemetry used for product/engineering troubleshooting are retained on a shorter window (default: 12 months); a separate set of billing-aggregates used to generate invoices is retained longer to satisfy finance/audit needs (default: 7 years).
- For EU-only retention: we support region-bound billing data for Dedicated/Private customers; for hosted customers we can place billing records in EU regions under contractual terms (we should confirm for your specific contract).

Expanded context: the reason we separate these categories is legal/finance obligations vs. user personal data. Invoices are treated as financial records and fall under retention obligations (tax, audit). Deletion requests targeting personal data do not automatically remove financial records that are required by law to be retained. However, personal identifiers in ancillary logs can be redacted if requested and if it does not interfere with financial record integrity.

I
(Posting Neha and Karthik to confirm the formal policy language we should share with Acme's audit docs.)

Best,
Marissa

- For hosted accounts (your current setup), if you need EU-only storage for billing artifacts we'll want to add that to the SOW/contract as a data residency constraint. It's doable but requires an amendment so invoices and related billing tables are pinned to the EU region.
- If your legal team needs a statement for the audit right away, we can provide a formal policy blurb, but regional guarantees require contractual language.

Hi Jenny and team — official finance/legal guidance below. Ive attached our internal invoice retention policy PDF and a DocuSign link template for a data residency amendment (attachment names included).

Official policy blurb for audits (you may copy/paste):

"Redwood Inference retains final invoice artifacts, associated invoice metadata, and billing reconciliations for a period of seven (7) years to comply with applicable tax and auditing requirements. These financial records are maintained separately from customer content used for model inference. Routine customer-initiated data deletion requests do not remove financial records that are required for regulatory or tax purposes. Where applicable, personal identifiers in ancillary logs can be redacted on request, subject to retention and legal requirements for financial record integrity."

Additional notes:
- Raw token-level telemetry and troubleshooting logs are retained for twelve (12) months by default; we can offer shorter windows as part of Dedicated/Private deployments or via contract for certain hosted customers.
- For EU-only billing storage, please let us know and we will initiate the contract amendment; DocuSign amendment template attached.

Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_Retention_Policy.pdf (policy summary)
             DocuSign_Amendment_Link.txt (link to amendment template)

If you want a one-page letter on Redwood letterhead, I can get Legal to sign off — tell me the recipient and well produce it.
